For traveling from the US to Europe, I recommend a Type C travel adapter with USB-C charging ports. It's compact and works in most European countries.

Which plug adapter do you need?

Switzerland, Liechtenstein

Important: Europe generally uses 220–240V power. Most modern phone and laptop chargers support 100–240V, but hair dryers and other appliances may require a voltage converter. A plug adapter alone does not convert voltage.
